risk_if_not_implemented: Without Decommissioning, sensitive and/or regulated data may be retained beyond authorized periods or recovered from improperly disposed media and equipment. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Retention / Inability to Dispose of Data (R-AM-3), Data Loss / Integrity Compromise (R-BC-2), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Secure Disposal, Destruction or Re-Use of Equipment
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to securely dispose of, destroy or repurpose technology assets using organization-defined techniques and methods to prevent:
(1) Data recovery; and
(2) Components from being resold, redistributed and/or reused through unauthorized channels.
compensating_control_1.justification: Secure Disposal, Destruction or Re-Use of Equipment (AST-22) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Decommissioning (AST-36) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
